## OperationId type

Stable identity of an operation: `app.resource.command` (or `app.app.command` for app-level commands), keyed by the manifest command key. It is the RPC route segment and the basis of MCP tool names.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type OperationId = `${string}.${string}.${string}`
```
